C0903.title: QQ Account Hijacking via Fake Game Login QR Codes Triggers Mass Spam
C0903.summary: In June 2022, a large number of QQ user accounts were compromised. The attackers sent unsolicited messages with inappropriate content to group chats and friends without the account owners' knowledge.
